question: As of November 2022, what is the capital of India's neighbouring country Bhutan?
solution:
The correct answer is __Thimphu__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bhutan:

 
 
• Thimphu__ is the capital of Bhutan.
 
• It is bordered by China and India.
 
• It is a landlocked country in South Asia.
 
• Bhutanese Ngultrum is the currency of Bhutan.
 
• 
 
Lotay Tshering is the current PM of Bhutan.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• ** Dhaka is the capital city of Bangladesh**, which is located to the east of Bhutan. It is the largest city in Bangladesh and serves as the economic and cultural hub of the country.
 
• **Paro is a town in western Bhutan,** located about 50 kilometers from Thimphu. It is known for its scenic beauty, traditional architecture, and historic landmarks, including the Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) monastery.
 
• ** Beijing is the capital city of China**, which is located to the north of Bhutan. It is one of the most populous cities in the world and serves as the political, cultural, and educational center of China.
